ऋ: ऋ ऋ, i. 1, ऋच्छ (in epic poetry also अर्च्छ = ἔρχομαι), ii. 3; 5; 9 Par.  1. To go.  2. To go to.  3. To undergo. With abstracts (cf. इ): Man. 1, 53, ग्लानिम् ऋच्छति, To become inert; MBh. 3, 2166, मृत्युम्, To die; अर्छ्, Nal. 7, 4; MBh. 3, 84; Nalod. 2, 10, युद्धरङ्गताम् आर, To become the field of battle.  4. To rise, ऋ-णु।  5. To meet, Man. 8, 351; to attain, Nalod. 1, 32; to fall on, Man. 8, 18, ऋच्छ।  6. To gain, to acquire.  7. To move, to raise, ved. ii. 3, इयर्मि।  8. To open, ii. 5.  9. To attack, MBh. 4, 1059, ऋच्छ।  10. To hurt; ऋत, and ऋते, see separately. -- Caus. अर्पय,  1. To cast; अर्पित, thrown, Ragh, 8, 87; turned, Bhag. 8, 7.  2. To fasten, Śāk. d. 133.  3. To pierce.  4. To put, Ragh. 9, 74.  5. To deliver, Yājñ. 2, 65; Daśak. in Chr. 183, 24; 201, 11.  6. To restore, Man. 8, 191. -- अर्पित।  1. Cut in, Śāk. d. 74.  2. Written, Ragh. 17, 79.  -- Comp. चित्र-, adj. painted, Śāk. d. 143. -- With the prepos. अभि अभि, To attack, MBh. 3, 11726, ऋच्छ, 11875 अर्च्छ। -- With आ आ।  1. To meet, MBh. 3, 17226.  2. To adapt (ved.). -- With प्र प्र, To rise, Chr. 288, 3 = Rigv. i. 49, 3. -- With प्रति प्रति, Caus.  1. To fasten, Ragh. 6, 28.  2. To deliver, Ragh. 15, 41.  3. To restore, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 15; 189, 15; 192, 16.  -- With वि वि, To open, Chr. 288, 15 = Rigv. i. 48, 15. -- With सम् सम्, Caus.  1. To cast, MBh. 1, 6978.  2. To deliver, Pañc. 36, 13.  3. To restore, Hit. 72, 20. -- समर्पित।  1. Fastened, Kumāras. 6, 63.  2. Put together, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 2.  3. Resting, Rām. 1, 77, 25.  4. Painted, Ragh. 3, 15. -- Cf. ἔρχομαι, ὄρνυμι, ἄρνυμαι, ἄρος, μισθαρνέω, ἰάλλω, ὄλλυμι (Lat. abolere), ἄρω, ἀρτίζω; Lat. orior, adorior, adolesco, adultus; Goth. alds; A.S. ald; O.H.G. arnên.
ऋक्वन्: ऋक्वन् ऋक्वन्, i. e. ऋच् + वन्।  I. adj. Praising.  II. m. A praiser, Chr. 293, 5 = Rigv. i. 87, 5.
ऋक्ष्: † ऋक्ष् ऋक्ष् (?), ii. 5, Par. To kill or hurt.
ऋक्ष: ऋक्ष ऋक्ष,  I. m. A bear, Rām. 3, 52, 45.  II. f. क्षी, A she-bear, Rām. 1, 16, 21.  III. m. and n.  1. A star, Rām. 5, 73, 57; MBh. 13, 625.  2. Bears and stars, Śiś. 9, 31.  IV. m. and f. क्षा, Proper names, MBh. 1, 3722; 3790. -- Cf. ἄρκτος; Lat. ursus.
ऋक्षवत्: ऋक्षवन्त् ऋक्ष + वन्त्, m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 6, 3, 10.
ऋक्षवन्त्: ऋक्षवन्त् ऋक्ष + वन्त्, m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 6, 3, 10.
ऋच्: ऋच् ऋच्, i. 1, Par.  1. To shine, ved.  2. i. 1, and † i. 6, Par. To praise, ved.  3. To honour, Man. 3, 93; anomal. absol. अर्च्य, Man. 1, 4. -- Caus. अर्चय, To honour, Man. 2, 181. अर्चित, Re-spectfully bestowed, Man. 4, 235. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To honour, Man. 8, 391. -- With समभि सम्-अभि, To honour, Yājñ. i. 226; to adore, 2, 112.  -- With प्रति प्रति,  1. To salute in turn, Rām. 2, 71, 31.  2. To salute one by one, MBh. 1, 7211. -- With सम् सम्, To adore, Rām. 2, 3, 48; to honour, MBh. 3, 11090 (properly 10190).

ऋच् ऋच्, f.  1. A verse or text of the Vedas, Man. 11, 142.  2. The Ṛg-veda, Man. 1, 23.  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. un-learned in holy texts, Man. 3, 131. त्र्य्-ऋच्, i. e. त्रि-, f. pl. three holy verses, Man. 2, 77.
ऋच: ऽऋच -ऋच् + अ। A substitute for ऋच् when being the latter part of a comp., e. g. अन्-, adj. Unlearned in holy texts, Man. 2, 158. त्र्यृच, i. e. त्रि-, n. A strophe consisting of three verses, Man. 11, 254.
ऋचीक: ऋचीक ऋचीक, m.  1. The name of a saint, Rām. 1, 35, 7.  2. The name of a country, Daśak. 193, 11.
ऋच्छ्: ऋछ् ऋछ् (properly the base of the pres. etc. of ऋ, q. cf.), i. 6, Par.; ep. also Ātm. (MBh. 4, 1056),  1. To go.  2. To attack, MBh. 3, 16375, आनर्छ, pf.  3. † To fail in faculties.  4. † To be-come stiff.
ऋछ्: ऋछ् ऋछ् (properly the base of the pres. etc. of ऋ, q. cf.), i. 6, Par.; ep. also Ātm. (MBh. 4, 1056),  1. To go.  2. To attack, MBh. 3, 16375, आनर्छ, pf.  3. † To fail in faculties.  4. † To be-come stiff.
ऋज्: ऋज् ऋज् (for primitive रज्), i. 1, Ātm.  1. † To go.  2. † To stand or to be firm.  3. † To gain.  4. † To be strong.  5. To live. -- Ved. i. 4, Par., and Ātm.  1. To stretch.  2. To desire, to strive for. -- Cf. रज् under ऋजु, ὀρέγω, ὀρέγνυμι, ὀριγνάομαι; , Lat. regere, rectus; Goth. rakian; A.S. reccan; Goth. raints, etc.
ऋजीष: ऋजीष ऋजीष (vb. ऋञ्ज्), n. The name of a hell, Man. 4, 90.
ऋजीषिन्: ऋजीषिन् ऋजीषिन् (vb. ऋज्), adj. Quick, Chr. 291, 12 = Rigv. i. 64, 12.
ऋजु: ऋजु ऋज्-उ, adj.  1. Straight, Man. 2, 47.  2. Right, Rām. 4, 34, 31. --Comparat. ऋजीयंस्, and ved. also रजी-यंस्; superl. ऋजिष्ठ, and ved. also रजिष्ठ।  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. crooked, Man. 4, 177. -- Cf. ὄρλυια, f. of ὀργυ, properly the measure of a tall upright man, i. e. six feet in general.
ऋजुता: ऋजुता ऋजु + ता, f.  1. Straightness, Kumāras. 4, 23.  2. Plainness, Amar. 67.
ऋञ्ज्: † ऋञ्ज् ऋञ्ज्, i. 1, Ātm. To fry.
ऋण्: † ऋण् ऋण्, ii. 8, Par., Ātm. (properly the base of the pres. etc. of ऋ, ii. 5), To go.
ऋण: ऋण ऋण, n. Obligation, Man 6, 35; a debt, Man. 9, 218.  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. free from obligation or debt, Man. 9, 106.
ऋणयावन्: ऋणयावन् ऋण-या + वन्, m. A pursuer of debts, Chr. 293, 4 = Rigv. i. 87, 4.
ऋणवत्: ऋणवन्त् ऋण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Indebted, Hit. Pr. d. 20, v. r.
ऋणवन्त्: ऋणवन्त् ऋण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Indebted, Hit. Pr. d. 20, v. r.
ऋणिन्: ऋणिन् ऋणिन्, i. e. ऋण + इन्, adj., f. नी।  1. Obligated, MBh. 1, 8341.  2. m. A debtor, Yājñ. 2, 86.
ऋत्: ऋत् ऋत्, the base of the pres., impf., imptve., and potent., and option-ally of all the other forms, is ऋतीय ऋतीय, Ātm. (properly a denomin. de-rived from ऋति).  1. † To blame.  2. To pity, Mālav. 55, 23.  3. † To rival.  4. To domineer.  5. † To go.
ऋत: ऋत ऋ + त,  I. adj., f. ता, True, Man. 8, 82.  II. n.  1. Truth, Rām. 5, 31, 19.  2. Gleaning, Man. 4, 5.  -- Comp. अन्-,  I. adj. untrue, Rām. 3, 53, 18; unjust, Man. 4, 170.  II. n. 1. untruth, Rām. 3, 53, 16; a lie, Chr. 48, 12. 2. agri-culture, Man. 4, 5. अपानृत, i. e. अप -अन्-ऋत, adj. true, Rām. 2, 34, 38. सत्य-अन्,  I. adj. true and false at the same time, Pañc. 98, 17.  II. n. com-merce, traffic. -- Cf. Lat. ratus, irritus; ἄρτις, ἀνάρτιος, ἀνάρσιος, ἀλιτέω, ἀλιταίνω, ἀλιτεύω, ἀλιτήμων.
ऋतम्भर: ऋतंभर ऋतंभर, i. e. ऋत + म् -भृ + अ,  I. m. A name of Brahman, Bhāg. P. 6, 13, 17.  II. f. रा, Under-standing, Prab. 68, 3.
ऋतंभर: ऋतंभर ऋतंभर, i. e. ऋत + म् -भृ + अ,  I. m. A name of Brahman, Bhāg. P. 6, 13, 17.  II. f. रा, Under-standing, Prab. 68, 3.
ऋतवत्: ऋतवन्त् ऋत + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessing truth, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 19.
ऋतवन्त्: ऋतवन्त् ऋत + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessing truth, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 19.
ऋतस्तुभ्: ऋतस्तुभ् ऋत-स्तुभ्, adj. Praising truth, Chr. 297, 20 = Rigv. i. 112, 20.
ऋति: ऋति ऋ + ति, f.  1. Way, Lass, 2, 8.  2. Attack (ved.).
ऋतीषह्: ऋतीषह् ऋतीषह्, i. e. ऋति-सह्, adj. Braving an attack, Chr. 291, 15 = Rigv. i. 64, 15.
ऋतु: ऋतु ऋ + तु, m.  1. Order (ved.).  2. Right time, Chr. 288, 3 = Rigv. i. 49, 3.  3. A season (of the year), Man. 3, 217.  4. The menstrual discharge, MBh. 14, 2739.  5. The season approved for sexual intercourse, Man. 3, 46, sqq.  -- Comp. अन्-, m. wrong season, Man. 4, 104; for sexual intercourse, 5, 153. The aff. तु is a form of त्वन् and ऋ of अर्; the older form would be * अर्त्वन् = Lat. ordo, base ordon. -- Cf. ἀρτύνω for ἀρτυν-ϳω, ἀρτύς, ἀρτύω.
ऋतुमती: ऋतुमती ऋतुमती, i. e. ऋतु + मन्त् + ई, f.  1. A woman in her courses, Suśr. 1, 317, 4.  2. A marriageable girl, Man. 9, 89.  3. A woman in the period approved for sexual intercourse, MBh. 1, 750.
ऋते: ऋते ऋते (loc. sing. ntr. of the ptcple. pf. pass. of ऋ, To go; properly, In defi-ciency), prep. with abl. and acc.  1. Wanting, Yājñ. 2, 117.  2. Except, MBh. 3, 16144; 3090.  3. Without, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 4; 191, 1.
ऋत्विज्: ऋत्विज् ऋत्विज्, i. e. ऋतु-यज्, m. A priest, who receives a stipend for pre-paring the holy fire and conducting sacrifices, Man. 2, 143.
ऋद्धि: ऋद्धि ऋद्धि, i. e. ऋध् + ति, f.  1. Plenty, Indr. 5, 26.  2. Wealth, Ku-māras. 2, 58.  3. Prosperity, Rām. 2, 105, 33.  4. Perfection, Bhāg. P. 9, 21, 12.  5. The deity of wealth, MBh. 13. 6750.
ऋद्धिमत्: ऋद्धिमन्त् ऋद्धि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती।  1. Wealthy, Rām. 5, 9, 63.  2. Prosperous, MBh. 3, 244.  3. Resplen-dent, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 3; beautiful, MBh. 3, 11077 (p. 572).
ऋद्धिमन्त्: ऋद्धिमन्त् ऋद्धि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती।  1. Wealthy, Rām. 5, 9, 63.  2. Prosperous, MBh. 3, 244.  3. Resplen-dent, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 3; beautiful, MBh. 3, 11077 (p. 572).
ऋध्: ऋध् ऋध्, i. 4, Par., ii. 5, Par. and ved. also i. 6 and ii. 7.  1. To prosper, Man. 9, 322 (ii. 5); MBh. 2, 1693 (i. 4); pass. To prosper, MBh. 3, 8488.  2. To augment (ved.).  3. † To please; ऋउअन, Prosperous, Ragh, 2, 50.  -- With सम् सम्, To prosper, Man. 9, 315 (ii. 5), MBh. 2, 1960 (i. 4); सम्-ऋद्ध।  1. Completed, Rām. 1, 44, 60.  2. Abundant, Rām. 2, 104, 26.  3. Abounding in (with instr. or abl.), Daśak. in Chr. 184, 14; Man. 3, 6.  4. Wealthy, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 15. -- Cf. ἄλθω; also ἀλδαίνω, etc., and ὀρόδαμνος; but ऋध् being compounded, viz. ऋ -धा, and the Vedas having a vb. ऋद्, which may be considered also as de-rived from ऋ, the base ἀλδ or ὀροδ may be another derivation from ऋ; cf. also Lat. ordior.
ऋफ्: † ऋफ् ऋफ्, and ऋम्फ् ऋम्फ्, i. 6, Par. To injure, to kill. -- Cf. ऋफ्।
ऋभु: ऋभु ऋभु, i. e. रभ् + उ, m. The name of certain deities, MBh. 3, 15459.
ऋष्: ऋष् ऋष्, i. 6, Par., ved. also i. 1; Par.  1. † To go.  2. To flow, to rain, to drip (ved. i. 1).  3. To pierce (ved. i. 6). -- Cf. Lat. rigare, rivus; Goth. rign; A.S. regen.
ऋषभ: ऋषभ ऋषभ, i. e. ऋष् + अन्-भ (vb. भा), m.  1. A bull, Bhāg. P. 1, 14, 19.  2. Chief, Bhāg. P. 2, 4, 22; especially as latter part of compound words, ‘best, excellent,’ e. g. पार्थिवर्-षभ, i. e. पार्थिव-, m. An excellent king, Chr. 55, 4. पुरुष-, m. An ex-cellent man, Rām. 3, 49, 11. भरत-, m. A noble descendant of Bharata, Chr. 24, 48. सिंह-, m. A fierce lion.
ऋषि: ऋषि ऋष् + इ (for original ऋषन्, cf. अक्षि for अक्षन्, अस्थि for अस्थन्, etc., = ἄρσην, ἄῤῥην), m.  1. A bard or author of sacred hymns, Chr. 287, 1. 3; Man. 11, 243.  2. An old saint, MBh. 12, 12724; Hariv. 417, seq.  3. A pious person, especially an anchorite, Man. 4, 94.  -- Comp. देवर्षि, i. e. देव-ऋषि, m. a sage of the class of demi-gods, as Nārada, VP. 284; Rām. 1, 1, 83. ब्रह्मर्षि, i. e. ब्रह्मन्- and विप्रर्-षि, i. e. विप्र-, m. a sage of the class of Brāhmaṇas, as Vaśiṣṭha, VP. 284; Chr. 22, 20; 14, 17. राजर्षि, i. e. राजन्-, m. a prince who has adopted a life of devotion, as Viśvāmitra, VP. 284; Chr. 11, 16; Pañc. 76, 9. सप्तर्षि, see separately.
ऋषित्व: ऋषित्व ऋषि-त्व, n. State of a ऋषि, MBh. 13, 2896.
ऋष्टि: ऋष्टि ऋष्टि, i. e. ऋष् + ति, f.  1. A spear, Chr. 290, 4 = Rigv. i. 64, 4.  2. A sword, Arj. 10, 20.
ऋष्टिमत्: ऋष्टिमन्त् ऋष्टि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Bearing spears, Chr. 293. 1 = Rigv. i. 88, 1.
ऋष्टिमन्त्: ऋष्टिमन्त् ऋष्टि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Bearing spears, Chr. 293. 1 = Rigv. i. 88, 1.
ऋष्य: ऋष्य ऋष्य, m. The painted or white-footed antelope, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 36; in ऋष्यरूपिन्, i. e. -रूप + इन्, adj. Having the shape of an antelope. In the Veda it is written ऋश्य; cf. O.H.G. elah, ἄλκη.
ऋष्यक: ऋष्यक ऋष्य + क, adj. Of the colour of the painted antelope, Rām. 5, 12, 35.
ऋष्यमूक: ऋष्यमूक ऋष्य-मूक, m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 1, 3, 22.
ऋष्व: ऋष्व ऋष्व, adj. Lofty, Chr. 290, 2 = Rigv. i. 64, 2.
